turns.content: My mum passed away six weeks ago. I'm trying to keep it together but it's really hard.
I'm so sorry for your loss. Six weeks is very recent. How are you holding up day to day?
Some days are okay. Other days I can barely get out of bed. I keep expecting her to call me.
That experience of expecting to hear from someone who's gone is incredibly painful. Do you have people around you?
My dad is a mess so I'm trying to support him. My sister lives far away. I feel totally alone in this. I've stopped eating properly.
You're carrying grief while also supporting your father — that's an enormous weight. Are you able to sleep?
A few hours at most. I've started drinking in the evenings just to fall asleep. I know it's not good but I don't care anymore.
Not caring about yourself can be a sign that the grief is becoming something heavier. Are you having any thoughts of harming yourself?
I've had thoughts that it would be easier to be with her. I know that's dark. I don't have a plan or anything but the thought is there.
